lines.en: One step clears two blocks.
The ground sinks under me.

lines.zh: 我的肩像一堵墙在移动。
lines.en: My shoulder moves like a wall.
Every step raises dust.
My legs are slow but long.
I knock down a low wall.
No road survives where I pass.
My fists hang at my sides.
I stop and look around.

lines.zh: 我迷过一次路，不想再迷。
lines.en: I lost my way once; I don't want to again.
I walk along the edge of the ruins.
My footfalls sound like thunder.
I stand taller than the roof.
I bend to read a signpost.
Cracks run all over my shell.
I am looking for a passable road.

lines.zh: 我把手搭在一块石头上。
lines.en: I rest a hand on a stone.
I stop before a broken wall.
I turn my head to the distance.
My toes dig into the earth.

lines.zh: 我把膝盖压在瓦砾上蹲下。
lines.en: I sink onto my knees in the rubble.
I count the road left.

lines.zh: 你站在我脚边，还没我脚掌大。
lines.en: You stand by my foot, smaller than it.
I bow my head and take you in.
Do you know the way?

lines.zh: 我又在这片废墟迷路了。
lines.en: I've lost my way in these ruins again.
Can you point me a direction?
I broke something by accident.
Further back; I need to turn.
I lift my feet slowly.
Your house sits at my shoulder.
One turn of mine can knock down a wall.
I step back and the ground jolts again.
A piece of my shell came off.
I barely felt that.

lines.zh: 我用一根手指按住裂口。
lines.en: I press a finger over the split.
I brace a hand on the wall beside me.
Rubble falls off my shoulder.
Something shudders in my chest.
I can still drag myself along.
I rest a hand on my knee.
This pain I can still bear.
What are you holding up?
I look down; it's too far.
You hold it up; I cannot make it out.
Set it on that broken stone.
Too far. My eyes can't resolve it.
Step back and I'll crouch.
That isn't enough for me.
I caught a smell.
That won't be one bite for me.
I crouch to look at your hands.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，退了好几步。
lines.en: You hit my leg and stagger back.

lines.zh: 你的冲撞只让我偏了偏。
lines.en: Your charge only tilts me a little.
I bear down; you can't shift me.
My foot nudges you aside.
Don't press close; I might step on you.
I move that foot aside.
The ground jolts when we collide.
My toe brushes your back.

lines.zh: 我低头找有没有压到人。
lines.en: I look down to check I didn't crush anyone.
Wait at the side.
This frame of mine isn't suited.
If I sit, I'd crush you.
I have been looking for a road.
I have no companion.
Don't climb onto my hand.
Sitting by the broken wall is enough.
Sit in my shadow.
I open my palm for you to stand on.
Talk; I am listening.
I rest my head on my knee.

lines.zh: 我把它在指间翻了个面。
lines.en: I turn it over between my fingers.
This is too small for me.

lines.zh: 我把它轻轻搁在石头上。
lines.en: I set it gently on a stone.
I can't see it; I bring it close.
It is like sand in my hand.
One squeeze of my fingers crushed it.
This could go under my foot.

lines.zh: 我把它收进胸口的凹处。
lines.en: I tuck it into the hollow in my chest.
Is this little thing yours?
I stoop and set it back on the slab.

lines.zh: 这条路上我只看得见你。
lines.en: You are the only one left on this road.
I check before lifting my foot.
You are standing in my footprint.
Turning is not easy for me.
You had better move.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子一点点转过来。
lines.en: I turn my whole bulk by degrees.
I stop walking. I have found you.
Don't stand by the wall.
One step crosses to you.
I don't want to crush you.
Back up; I'm lifting a foot.
I have lifted a foot.
You're blocking the only road.
I move my foot off this spot.
I must see clearly before I step.
These walls are shorter than me.
I follow you, slowly.
I have noted your road.

lines.zh: 你拐进巷子，我绕到另一头。
lines.en: You take the alley; I go around it.
One of my steps is two blocks.
Don't run into a narrow alley.

lines.zh: 我在那片废墟旁边等你。
lines.en: I wait by that ruin.
Do you hear the rubble hopping?
I have raised my foot.
You are behind a wall too short for this.
One more step and I'm there.
I bend down, and my shadow presses close.
The ground here won't hold me.
I brace a hand on the broken wall.
One turn of mine brings down a stretch.
You've backed into the ruins.
I lower myself to look at you.

lines.zh: 我一步步跟着你的脚印。
lines.en: I follow your footprints step by step.
You have only one way out.
My head turning sounds like far thunder.
The ground has started to rumble.
I bring my palm down.
That cracked the ground.

lines.zh: 我的拳头在墙那边落下。
lines.en: My fist comes down past the wall.
The impact bounces you up.
I push and you slide.
I stamp, very slowly.
Bricks fly everywhere.
My hand's back sweeps you.
I tried to hold back.

lines.zh: 我落脚的地方空出来了。
lines.en: The ground where I step is clear.

lines.zh: 我尽力收着力气挥过去。
lines.en: I swing as gently as I can.
I knock down a wall.
Bricks fall all over you.
I lower my bulk.
I tried to be gentle with that.
My palm lands and the bricks leap.
My foot lands beside you.
I raise a hand and you back off.
Dust separates us.
I don't want to take another step.
The rubble slides away as I rise.
I am taller than I thought.
My feet are sunk in rubble.
I push the wall beside me away.
All the roads here are broken.

lines.zh: 我把背上的砖一块块抖落。
lines.en: I shake the bricks off my back one by one.
The dust takes a while to settle.
I look down for a signpost.
I'm not sure which way is which.
I hear someone walking far off.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀从瓦砾里挪开。
lines.en: I shift my shoulder out of the rubble.
I start looking for the road.

lines.zh: 火在我背上烧，我不太在意。
lines.en: Fire burns on my back; I hardly mind.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我半个身子陷进地里。
lines.en: I fell and half my body sank into the earth.
The water only reaches my knees, but it's cold.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀掉了我肩上一片。
lines.en: The blast tore a patch off my shoulder.
Something stuck in my finger.
Spell-light spreads over my shell.

lines.zh: 我走了太久，没找到补给。
lines.en: I walked too long without supplies.

lines.zh: 雷打在我肩上，麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shoulder and it goes numb.
The ground gives and I sink.
